page.overview:
Who is Skidmark?

No one would ever suspect the duality that lies within Skidmark. Whenever you meet him, he is annoyingly polite and so well-groomed he puts everyone to shame. He has an extreme keen sense for detail that borders on the obsessive-compulsive. You can expect his equipment and station to be just as spotless and clear from any detritus. The difference happens when you put him behind anything with a steering wheel and the mild-mannered boy scout becomes a hellion on the road.

In the Marvel Comics G.I. Joe series, he first appeared in issue No. 72. He joins the team at the same time as Wildcard and Windmill. A Cobra agent, the Star Viper, sneaks onto the Joe's Utah base by holding onto the underside of Skidmark's Desert Fox vehicle. Skidmark and the new Joes pursue the Viper in the next issue 73.

Skidmark returns in the Devil's Due G.I. Joe series in issue No. 24. He is one of the many Joes recalled up to duty for the second Cobra civil war, this one also taking place on Cobra Island. In issue No. 25, Skidmark is killed by a falling helicopter crash while aiding General Hawk in an attempt to arrest Overlord. Skidmark is featured in the 1989 'Golden' G.I. Joe coloring book
